brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536x864 or larger. This is a fresh composition, not a photo.
Visual style: approved editorial basketball ink illustration; nearly-black #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes, warm off-white bold typography, dramatic expressive hand-drawn black ink hatching. Restrained palette with orange only for the basketball. Strong contrast, simple composition, no photorealism.
Subject: draw exactly ONE real player, Yuki Togashi (富樫勇樹), in a dynamic low dribble stance, three-quarter body leaning forward on the RIGHT 43 percent of the canvas, head turned slightly toward left, one hand controlling the ball low beside his hip, opposite arm bent naturally. His face must be recognizable rather than a generic player.
Official appearance reference inspected at https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/704/2026-27/9055_03.png, linked through official profile https://www.bleague.jp/roster_detail/?PlayerID=9055 . Recreate the observed face in drawn ink only: compact athletic Japanese adult man; short-to-medium dark hair parted at the center with gently wavy curtain strands swept outward above and around the ears; forehead visible, softly angular oval face, prominent cheekbones, slightly narrow almond eyes, straight medium nose, light sparse moustache and a distinct short small chin goatee, not a full beard. Keep face lit with off-white planes and legible features. Plain off-white basketball vest and shorts with dark trim. Absolutely no uniform words, numbers, badges, team/league logos, sponsor marks or copied photo pixels.
Composition: large clean Japanese type on LEFT 56 percent, player on right with lime brush speed diagonals behind him. The hands and complete orange ball stay inside the frame; anatomically coherent arms and fingers. Head, hands and ball must not overlap any text. Maintain generous safe padding about 5 percent at all edges. Deliberate crop at lower thighs is acceptable; no cropping of face, ball, hands or lettering.
Text: render ONLY the following exact strings, correct Japanese, no invented copy.
Top left small publication header: 「バスケまとめ」
Below it medium date: 「2026.11.10」
Small category kicker: 「B.PREMIER」
Huge bold white main heading: 「試合結果」
Second large heading: 「当日のEFF」
Prominent lime brush strip with bold dark lettering: 「ポジション別TOP3」
Smaller clear qualifier below headings: 「B.ONE・B.NEXTは試合なし」
Bottom left readable off-white disclosure with ample bottom margin: 「イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ」
All type must remain easy to read at thumbnail scale; Japanese gothic heavy sans, brush texture confined mostly to backgrounds rather than letter interiors.
Editorial meaning: this thumbnail summarizes the fixed article's 2026-11-10 completed game results and official EFF rankings by position, not season averages or predictions. Togashi was RANDOMLY selected from the players named in the article as an illustration subject only. Do not print his name, his individual statistics, attendance, rank or any claim of his performance. TOP3 describes the article's position-based rankings collectively. The dribbling pose is a conceptual illustration, NOT a recreation of a particular game moment. No scores, opponent, hoop, arena, crowd, trophy, additional players or unrelated numbers.
Deliver one polished raster PNG with an opaque dark background.
